subject: POC runway extension and modular billing options - Kestrel Labs
messages:
From: Alyssa Hart <alyssa@kestrel-labs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC runway: looking to extend 3 weeks + simplified billing

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the server time during our POC — the team has finished the second integration sprint and we are close to validating the embedding recall improvements. Two asks from product + finance:

1) We need a 3-week runway extension (current POC ends next Monday). The extension is to finish the end-to-end evaluation and a short load test.
2) Finance would prefer a simple, single-line invoice rather than hourly seat billing. They asked whether you offer a short-term credit pack (token/embedding credits) we can buy for the extra weeks versus a prorated day extension.

Attached are the latest POC metrics (current_poc_metrics.csv) so you can see usage shape — it's mostly embedding calls with occasional generation spikes. Can you outline options and a ballpark cost for both a prorated time extension and a small credit pack? Also need any addendum language for our procurement team so we can sign quickly.

CCing Paul (finance).

—Alyssa
Alyssa Hart
Head of ML, Kestrel Labs
alyssa@kestrel-labs.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Hart <alyssa@kestrel-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC runway: looking to extend 3 weeks + simplified billing

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the context and the metrics, that helps a lot. We can do both approaches; spelled out below so you can show Paul:

Option A — Time extension (prorated)
- 3-week extension added to the existing POC term
- Discount: 30% off list day rate for short-term runway additions
- Includes an extra 4 hours of on-call engineering support (single-week window) to help with the load test
- Quick addendum (1 page) to sign, no changes to feature access

Option B — Modular credit pack
- 200k token-equivalent credit pack priced at a 15% discount to hosted pay-as-you-go rates
- Credits consumed by tokens (embedding + generation) with roll-forward only to the end of the extended window
- Includes one operational sync and a delivery note with per-endpoint consumption guidance

Tradeoffs: credits are faster to invoice and reason about in a single line item (Finance-friendly). The prorated time extension keeps billing aligned to the POC term and is simpler contractually. Either option can be converted into a commit if you decide to go longer — I can include a conversion credit: 12% of the extension/credits applied as future credit toward a 6-month commit if signed in 30 days.

Next steps from our side: I can draft the 1-page addendum for Option A or the simple invoice + DocuSign for Option B depending on what Paul prefers. Which would you like us to prepare? Once you confirm, Marissa and Karthik will fast-track legal/finance review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that helps.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Hart <alyssa@kestrel-labs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC runway: looking to extend 3 weeks + simplified billing

Alyssa — quick note from pricing/legal ops: we can approve Option B (modular credit pack) as a standard short-term purchase. I'm attaching a pricing grid that shows the pack sizes and discounts (stitching_pricing_grid.xlsx). For Kestrel's usage profile, the 200k-credit pack is the best fit.

Additional incentive: if Kestrel converts to a 6-month reserved commitment within 30 days of the addendum, we'll apply a conversion credit equal to 12% of the credits purchased (applied to the first invoice). That needs a quick signature on the addendum + a purchase order.

Finance note: we can shorten invoicing lead time to 7 days if Paul sends a PO referencing deal KST-1492. We'll generate a single-line invoice and a DocuSign statement of work addendum.

Attaching: stitching_pricing_grid.xlsx and kestrel_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal with the addendum language inline). Jonas — please queue DocuSign once they confirm.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Alyssa Hart <alyssa@kestrel-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Le <paul.le@kestrel-labs.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC runway: looking to extend 3 weeks + simplified billing

Thanks Jonas and Marissa — that looks good. Kestrel will take Option B (200k credit pack) with the 12% conversion credit holdback. Paul — please confirm PO reference and billing window; Finance prefers the single-line invoice and the 7-day lead.

Paul, you can use PO# KEST-PO-551 and email it to finance@redwood.ai. If you can sign the DocuSign link (Jonas/Marissa), we can get the credits issued the same day.

Jonas — please send the DocuSign link and the invoice. We'll route to procurement and confirm by EOD.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alyssa
